result.summary: The page largely renders correctly. The main visual oddity is a misaligned decorative circle in the green promotional banner; otherwise no significant defects are apparent beyond expected scrollable and viewport-cropped content.

issues.description: The promotional banner contains a large, partially transparent circle graphic that appears misaligned and overlaps the banner content and edges, creating an unintended visual artifact.
issues.suggestion: Reposition or resize the decorative circle so it stays within the banner and does not awkwardly intersect the text or button.
